(b) 'subscripted by the first index-name' -- pb445-search-all-sending-uses-index writes `K (IX) = V (IX)` where V is not a key, so only this half fires. The rule reaches BOTH a sole identifier-3/-4 and every identifier inside arithmetic-expression-1/-2, and the implementation walks the whole expression subtree for the latter; the positive golden's cases B and C are the legal identifier-3 and arithmetic-expression-1 spellings.
